say:1:1433003001:0.text: Young one, you'd be surprised how much a fishing rod can teach you about life.
say:1:1433003001:0.source_cn: 年轻人，这世上的道理，鱼竿都能教给你。
say:1:1433003001:0.male: Young one, you'd be surprised how much a fishing rod can teach you about life.
say:1:1433003001:0.female: Young one, you'd be surprised how much a fishing rod can teach you about life.

say:3:1433003002:0.text: Back in my day, I entered the capital as a servant, dreaming of making a name for myself.
say:3:1433003002:0.source_cn: 想我年轻的时候，也是雄心壮志，进王城当了仆从，想着从此...
say:3:1433003002:0.male: Back in my day, I entered the capital as a servant, dreaming of making a name for myself.
say:3:1433003002:0.female: Back in my day, I entered the capital as a servant, dreaming of making a name for myself.

say:4:1433003003:0.text: But what did the city's splendor have to do with me? I wasted many years, endured much hardship, and in the end, I was merely a passerby.
say:4:1433003003:0.source_cn: 可王城的繁华跟我又有什么关系呢？蹉跎了好多年，吃了不少...
say:4:1433003003:0.male: But what did the city's splendor have to do with me? I wasted many years, endured much hardship, and in the end, I was merely a passerby.
say:4:1433003003:0.female: But what did the city's splendor have to do with me? I wasted many years, endured much hardship, and in the end, I was merely a passerby.

say:5:1433003004:0.text: Just like the fish in this lake—fat and lively, but none ever bite my hook. What do they have to do with me?
say:5:1433003004:0.source_cn: 就像这湖里的鱼，各个都个大肥美，不愿意上我的钩，它们又...
say:5:1433003004:0.male: Just like the fish in this lake—fat and lively, but none ever bite my hook. What do they have to do with me?
say:5:1433003004:0.female: Just like the fish in this lake—fat and lively, but none ever bite my hook. What do they have to do with me?

say:6:1433003005:0.text: What I regret most after leaving the capital? Never getting to fish here in peace.
say:6:1433003005:0.source_cn: 王城啊……离开王城以后，最遗憾的就是从来没在王城里痛痛...
say:6:1433003005:0.male: What I regret most after leaving the capital? Never getting to fish here in peace.
say:6:1433003005:0.female: What I regret most after leaving the capital? Never getting to fish here in peace.

say:7:1433003006:0.text: They say there's a rare and beautiful fish in the Tenebris Court...
say:7:1433003006:0.source_cn: 据说永夜圣庭里有一种鱼，样貌极为美丽……
say:7:1433003006:0.male: They say there's a rare and beautiful fish in the Tenebris Court...
say:7:1433003006:0.female: They say there's a rare and beautiful fish in the Tenebris Court...

say:8:1433003007:0.text: Maybe you'll get the chance to see it for me, young one.
say:8:1433003007:0.source_cn: 年轻人，说不定你有机会能替我看一眼呢。
say:8:1433003007:0.male: Maybe you'll get the chance to see it for me, young one.
say:8:1433003007:0.female: Maybe you'll get the chance to see it for me, young one.
